description: GLEAM is the Food and Agriculture Organization's R implementation of its Global Livestock Environmental Assessment Model. It simulates herd structure, animal products, feed and energy needs, nitrogen balance, and emissions from livestock, manure and feed supply. The documented species are cattle, buffalo, camels, goats, pigs and sheep. Inputs are herd, feed, management and regional assumptions; outputs include annual production and allocated greenhouse-gas emissions. Geography is set by the user's livestock system, with cohort and annual calculations, not a fixed geospatial grid in this package. FAO offers source on GitHub under AGPL-3.0 with instructions for installation from the repository. The README requests that users inform the team of use, but describes that as a request, not an access gate. A limitation is that modelled emissions depend on herd and feed data and should not be read as direct measurements. It supports agricultural food-supply and emissions scenario modelling. The catalogue's model-capri-agricultural-sector-model is a distinct agricultural economic model for comparison; no interoperability was verified. No package was installed.
